examples.lyrics:
[Verse]
Break dance is back
Oh yeah
It’s here (ooh-yeah!)
Get ready to move
Let’s make it clear
Show your style
Don't hold back
No fear
Party all night
Let's cheer
Let's cheer

[Verse 2]
On the floor
We twist and spin (spin-spin!)
Feel the rhythm
Let’s begin
Show your moves
Let the fun begin
Break dance fever
Feel it within

[Chorus]
Take your chance
Take your chance
Show your moves in a dance trance
Everybody
Let’s advance
Break the floor
Take your chance

[Verse 3]
The beat is hot
The floor’s on fire (fire-fire!)
Keep on groovin’
Never tire
Dance to the drum
Let’s rise higher
Sweat and smiles
Our desire

[Chorus]
Take your chance
Take your chance
Show your moves in a dance trance
Everybody
Let’s advance
Break the floor
Take your chance

[Bridge]
Round and round
We'll never stop (never stop!)
To the top
We’re gonna pop
Feel the groove
Let it drop (drop-drop)
Break dance moves
Make it pop

examples.style: Deep house, analog synths, smooth bass, airy pads, hypnotic groove, vocal chops, late-night vibe, 118 bpm.
examples.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Smooth bassline rolls in with airy pads and subtle vocal chops, setting a dark, hypnotic vibe.]

[Verse 1]
Night falls, we drift into the sound,
Lost in the beat, there’s no way out.
Feel the rhythm, taking control,
Let it pull you deep, feel the flow.

[Chorus - Hypnotic and simple]
In the midnight flow, let it go,
Lose yourself, just take it slow,
In the dark, we’re free to move,
Caught up in this endless groove.
(Midnight flow...)
(Let it go...)

[Verse 2]
Lights low, shadows on the wall,
Echoes of you, I hear it all.
One more breath, we fall in time,
We’re drifting, babe, we cross the line.

[Chorus - Repeat, building in energy]
In the midnight flow, let it go,
Lose yourself, just take it slow,
In the dark, we’re free to move,
Caught up in this endless groove.
(Midnight flow...)
(Let it go...)

[Bridge - Instrumental with vocal chops and airy pads, creating a trance-like build]
[The groove deepens, with vocal chops weaving in and out, as bass and synths rise subtly, keeping a smooth vibe.]

[Final Chorus - Climactic but still smooth, keeping that deep vibe]
In the midnight flow, let it go,
Lose yourself, just take it slow,
In the dark, we’re free to move,
Caught up in this endless groove.
(Midnight flow...)
(Let it go...)

[Outro]
[Airy pads fade out, leaving the smooth bass and vocal echoes lingering softly into the night.]
